newsitem.title: USA: U.S. DLA expects to announce cobalt sale Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. DLA expects to announce cobalt sale Tuesday.

text.p: The U.S. Defense Logistics Agency said it expected to announce results of its cobalt tender later Tuesday.
Agency officials were scheduled to begin a meeting at 1300 EST/1800 GMT to decide which bids to accept, and expected to announce sales by 1630 EST, stockpile spokesman Peter Roman said.
An agency official had previously said that results would be released Thursday.
The stockpile offered to sell 1,000,000 pounds of cobalt contained under its sealed-bid format.
It received bids Monday for a total of 999,537 pounds, ranging from $10.00 per pound for 993 pounds of 99.30 percent cobalt to $20.39 per pound for two bids of 29,946 pounds of 99.42 percent cobalt.
